data.long_meaning: The name Daliah is derived from the Arabic word 'dalala' which means 'to guide'. Daliah is a name of a woman mentioned in the Quran who was a guide for her people. It is also a name of a river mentioned in the Quran. The name Daliah represents the idea of being a guide, a helper, and a nurturer. The name Daliah carries the meaning “Slender or delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Daliah usually hope their child will grow to embody slender or delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is one of the names that carry beautiful and delicate meanings, often given to lovely girls. Etymologically, the name is derived from the Arabic root 'D-L-Y' which signifies 'to draw water' or 'to branch out', symbolizing growth and beauty.
